messages:
alex: evening async — quick quiet-window check before I sign off for the night. TL;DR: p99 latency OK, p95 spike earlier; alert noise from model-cache-evict; RMQ ack backlog on us-west. What I did / blockers / plan:

maria: saw the p95 blip at ~21:12 UTC. Looks correlated with long sequences (>1024). Will run a synthetic run with seq=1500 to confirm.

tom: I pushed a small alert tweak to staging to debounce model-cache-evict alerts. PR `#4672` — change is composite: `rate>10 && p95>200ms` + 10m silence on canary.

jin: RMQ ack backlog — I'm collecting worker logs. worker-7 has a restart loop (backoff) starting ~21:05. Suspect consumer reconnect thrash after backpressure change. Pulling traces now.

alex: good catch. If worker-7 is the culprit, let's temporarily suppress noisy PD pages and attach the investigation note to the alert. @tom can you add a sticky annotation? :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PD-3482 silenced by alex for 10m — reason: investigating worker-7 restart loop and RMQ ack backlog.

maria: running synthetic load now: 20 qps, seq 1500, 5m window. I'll post results and perf summary in this thread.

tom: updated alert config in staging. Will promote to prod after we confirm synthetic doesn't trigger false positives. Watching oncall channel for 10m.

jin: uploaded logs: `s3://redwood-logs/worker7/restarts/3921234567.log` — contains stack traces and reconnect timing. Initial look: consumer handled 3 rapid reconnects then crashed on OOM? collecting heap dump.

alex: blockers: RMQ ack/backlog + confirming long-seq perf. Owners: jin (RMQ), maria (synthetic/kv hit), tom (alert tuning). If anything escalates, wake me. I'll check in tomorrow morning.

maria: results: KV hit-rate dropped ~12% during the synthetic run, p95 rose to ~260ms for long seqs. Uploading csv and flame graphs to the shared folder.

tom: promoted debounce change to prod with a 1h canary. If noise persists, switch to `composite && runbook` path. PR link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4672

jin: heap dump attached: `s3://redwood-dumps/worker7/heap-3921234567.hprof`. OOM likely due to stale KV entries and a mem leak in batcher path. I'll open a draft patch.

alex: action summary: 1) jin to prototype leak fix + hotpatch candidate; 2) maria to run additional long-seq sweep tomorrow AM; 3) tom to monitor alert behavior and rollback debounce if needed. Thanks all. Good night.
